description: Cross-project failure knowledge sharing layer (Phase 6). Structured data store for failure fingerprints and resolution hints. Peer suggestions before task execution. Role-scoped knowledge — workers learn from workers in other projects. Mirrors the Phase 6 Guild Layer architecture.
instructions: When a task fails after max retries, publish the FailureContext to the guild store (capability, input shape, error class, resolution if found).
Before attempting a task similar to a known failure, check guild for prior resolutions and apply them as input hints or approach adjustments.
Knowledge is organized by (capability + error fingerprint) key — resolution hint.
A worker role in Project A can learn from a worker role in Project B that hit the same capability failure.
Guild knowledge is structured data, not LLM embeddings. Works without a model in the loop.
Opt-in per deployment — a deployment handling sensitive data can operate fully isolated.
